checks: provisional_path inverts actual provisional_cases, dispatching on recipient to the same root Lambda/Theta request, exact returned world/gas/substate/status, and ExactDone tree. It makes no successful-status restriction.

result_path inverts actual Upsilon result_equation and the same provisional result. It derives cleanup frame from that result journal code/exclusion, and checkpoint frame from transaction admission. Both frames contribute empty occurrence lists; the witness list and exactList proof are retained literally, only nil append simplification is needed.

receipt_replay obtains canonical tree_cert, Ready, numeric adequacy and per-call independent inputs from actual funding/admission history. JournalRetainedPaths.extract produces ExactDone; JournalCheckpoints supplies the same root final journal. No Path, final queue or per-child invariant postcondition is an input.

The final returned tuple contains the actual-world Path, complete occurrence-address-list equality to independent retainedList, derived Nodup via retainedList_nodup, and physical final queue representation of replay over that identical occurrence witness.

BasePath=[] transport simplifies exactly to the unprefixed retainedList. Exact list equality preserves structural execution order as proved in JournalRetainedPaths/JournalRetainedCalls, not just set membership.

history_replay extracts the real prefix for the selected receipt LIST POSITION, including preceding SYSTEM/transfer/credit edges. Prefix credits/work inequalities and one initial seed derive the transaction invariant and funding; supplied representation chooses only its physical prequeue. The same receipt/tree and total history bounds feed receipt_replay.

Initial invariant for receipt_replay, or initial history seed invariant/funding plus total bounds for history_replay.

limitations: This closes exact retained-list witness and per-root address uniqueness at the actual transaction-world queue consumer. It does not claim every arbitrary Path inhabitant has that canonical list.
Nodup is scoped to occurrence addresses in one actual transaction tree. Cross-transaction identity needs the transaction list position plus local path; identical receipts or payloads remain allowed.
Retained list includes failed atomic calls, getters and SYSTEM calls; successful-submission and committed-log equations remain separate consumers.
No reference-protocol history extraction, genesis/deployment producer, gas/semantic transport or SYSTEM scheduling/resource closure.
